run_multi_obj_tracking: run the multi-object 3D tracking example using RBGTTracker with ape and squirrel models
create_dotdict_config: create a dotdict configuration object with attribute-style access for RBGT tracker settings
initialize_RBGTTracker: initialize an RBGTTracker instance with a config containing model paths and visualization options
track_with_RBOTDatasetHandle: track objects by creating an RBOTDatasetHandle and passing it to the tracker track method
output_tracking_results: output tracking results by calling the tracker output method in a loop
